publisher: Office for National Statistics / ONS Geography
boundary_resolution: BFC full resolution - clipped to coastline (Mean High Water mark)
blocker_detail: The official data.gov.uk page exposes the WFS endpoint. Runtime web transport reached the WFS link but rejected its text/xml response as unsupported; direct container network access also failed DNS resolution. No WFS feature geometry was fabricated.
method_change: Changed from prior BFC KML/KMZ replica download to the separately published OGC WFS service.
license_context: Dataset page license field is not set; page states the dataset contains ONS and Ordnance Survey intellectual property rights. National Data Library footer states OGL v3.0 except where otherwise stated.
